message.tycoonrogue.robber.stole: That customer was a robber! He stole %s emeralds! Catch him!
message.tycoonrogue.robber.empty: That customer was a robber, but he found no emeralds on you.
message.tycoonrogue.scammer.escape: That customer was a scammer! He took your goods and ran without paying! Catch him!
message.tycoonrogue.raid.alert: WARNING: Armed raiders have been spotted near your factory!
message.tycoonrogue.raider.ransack: The raiders are ransacking your chests! Stop them!
reason.tycoonrogue.gun_threat: pointed a gun at a customer
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.picky.1: Hmph. Let's see if this place is any good.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.picky.2: I hope the quality here is acceptable.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.chatty.1: Oh hi! Lovely weather, isn't it? Anyway, listen!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.chatty.2: Hey hey! I've heard so much about this place!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.generous.1: What a wonderful place! I'm in a spending mood!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.generous.2: Hello, friend! I'm happy to pay well today.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.thanks.shy.2: That was... really nice of you.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.thanks.picky.2: Not bad. I might come back.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.thanks.chatty.1: Wow, thanks! I'm telling everyone about this!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.thanks.chatty.2: Amazing! Wait till I post about this!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scared.picky.1: This is outrageous! I'll never shop here again!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scared.chatty.1: Help! Somebody! Everyone's gonna hear about this!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scared.chatty.2: Hands up?! I'm telling the whole town!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scared.generous.1: Take it easy! I'll pay whatever, just don't!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scared.generous.2: Calm down, friend! No need for that!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.shy.1: Um... I think that's the wrong one...
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.picky.1: Are you blind? That's not what I asked for!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.chatty.1: Haha, nope, not that one! I need exactly what I said!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.chatty.2: Oh dear, mixed up the order, did you?
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.generous.1: No worries, but that's not quite it!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.generous.2: Nice try, friend, but I need the other thing!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.order.plain.1: I'm looking for %2$s of %1$s. Can you supply them?
dialogue.tycoonrogue.order.plain.3: My shop is out of %1$s. %2$s should do it.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.gossip.plain.1: Did you hear? Someone pulled a gun on a customer at that factory!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.gossip.plain.2: I heard the owner scares customers. I'm staying away.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.gossip.plain.3: Rumor has it there's trouble at that factory...
dialogue.tycoonrogue.robber_reveal.plain: Hand it over! This was a robbery all along!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scammer_reveal.plai: Haha, sucker! Thanks for the free goods!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.raider_charge.plain: Nobody move! This is a robbery!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.raider_flee.plain.2: Fall back! We got the loot!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.taste_history.plain: Did you know some of these machines look like ancient engineering?
I love anything with a story behind it.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.taste_cars.plain.1: A good engine sound makes my day.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.taste_cars.plain.2: Do you build anything with wheels here?
dialogue.tycoonrogue.taste_airplanes.pla: I dream of building a plane someday.
Anything that flies, I want it.
I can't think straight without coffee.
The smell of roasted beans... heaven.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.taste_cola.plain.2: Is there something fizzy around here?
